intro: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops! is a seasonal quest where an adventurer gathers holiday sweets on behalf of Spoops, who is too ill to go trick-or-treating. In exchange for treats gathered from city innkeepers and Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village, Spoops offers magical candy that transforms the eater into funny and frightening shapes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
